Container.Name: Audiobind
Container.Overview: Merges multi-part audiobook rips into a single tagged m4b, verifies each book against the Audible catalog, embeds real chapters and cover art, and files the result as Author/Title. Converts only what it is confident about.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: audiobook m4b merge convert chapters metadata audible audnex audiobookshelf

Config.Name: Library path
Config.Description: Folder holding the audiobooks to fix. Read-only.

Config.Name: Output path
Config.Description: Where finished m4b files are written.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, audit report and work files.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Status page and JSON API (container port is 8080).

Config.Name: Auto convert
Config.Description: Which confidence tiers convert without asking: high, medium or off.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = decide and log everything but write nothing. Set false to start converting.

Config.Name: Scan interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to look for new books.

Config.Name: Audio bitrate
Config.Description: AAC bitrate for the output m4b.

Config.Name: Nice level
Config.Description: CPU priority for ffmpeg. Higher = yields to other work.

Config.Name: Max runtime delta
Config.Description: Hold a book when its runtime differs from the catalog by more than this fraction.

Config.Name: Region
Config.Description: Audible region: us, ca, uk, au, fr, de, it, es, jp, in.

Config.Name: Notify URL
Config.Description: Optional webhook (Discord/Slack/ntfy) for a per-scan summary.
